subject: shinyjs::toggleState on actionButton in a renderUI

messages.author: bdb7eff1fb889798
messages.subject: shinyjs::toggleState on actionButton in a renderUI
parts:
I've put the toggleState with a condition in an observe, but the associated actionButton is in a renderUI such that the condition has been evaluated before the button is rendered. is there a way to have the condition to evaluate only after the button is rendered?

PS: an unrelated question, how best to reset a form on renderUI (as shinyjs::reset wouldn't work in such a case)?

Thank you very much.
